mapper.select: select c.*,u.user_name as userName,u.avatar as userAvatar from contract c left join contract_and_user ca on c.id = ca.contract_id left join tb_user u on u.user_id = c.user_id where c.user_id = #{userId} and c.draft_status = 0 group by c.id order by c.create_time desc

select c.*,u.user_name as userName,u.avatar as userAvatar from contract c left join contract_and_user ca on c.id = ca.contract_id left join tb_user u on u.user_id = c.user_id where ca.copy_user = #{userId} and c.draft_status = 0 group by c.id order by c.create_time desc

select c.*,u.avatar as userAvatar from contract c left join contract_and_user ca on c.id = ca.contract_id left join tb_user u on u.user_id = c.user_id where (c.user_id = #{userId} or ca.signed_by = #{userId})
and c.contract_name like concat('%',#{contractName},'%')
and c.is_complete = #{isComplete}
and c.draft_status = 0 group by c.id order by c.create_time desc
select count(1) from contract c left join contract_and_user ca on c.id = ca.contract_id where ca.copy_user = #{userId}
select count(1) from contract c left join contract_and_user ca on c.id = ca.contract_id where ca.user_id = #{userId}
select count(1) from contract c left join contract_and_user ca on c.id = ca.contract_id where ca.copy_user = #{userId}

select COUNT(1) from contract c left join contract_and_user ca on c.id = ca.contract_id and ca.status in (0, 1) where (ca.user_id = #{userId} and ca.signed_by != #{userId}) or (ca.user_id != #{userId} and ca.signed_by = #{userId})
select c.* from contract c left join contract_and_user ca on c.id = ca.contract_id where ca.copy_user = #{userId} and c.draft_status = 0
select count(1) from contract c left join contract_and_user ca on c.id = ca.contract_id where ca.signed_by = #{userId} and ca.status = 0
select count(1) from contract c left join contract_and_user ca on c.id = ca.contract_id where ca.signed_by = #{userId} and ca.status = 1
select count(1) from contract c where c.user_id = #{userId} and c.draft_status = 1

select c.*,u.user_name as userName,u.avatar as userAvatar from contract c left join contract_and_user ca on c.id = ca.contract_id left join tb_user u on u.user_id = c.user_id where ca.user_id = #{userId} and c.draft_status = 1 order by c.create_time desc

select c.*,u.user_name as userName,u.avatar as userAvatar from contract c left join contract_and_user ca on c.id = ca.contract_id left join tb_user u on u.user_id = c.user_id where ca.signed_by = #{userId} and ca.sign_or_approved = 0 and ca.status = 0 order by c.create_time desc

select c.* from contract c left join contract_and_user ca on c.id = ca.contract_id and ca.status = 1 where (ca.user_id = #{userId} or ca.signed_by = #{userId}) and ca.sign_or_approved = 1 order by c.create_time desc

select count(*) from contract where 1 = 1
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') = date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{date},'%Y')

select count(*) from contract c where 1 = 1 and c.is_complete = 1
and date_format(c.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') = date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(c.create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(c.create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{date},'%Y')
